name: Musco Center for the Arts
tagline: Premier 1,044-seat concert hall & cultural landmark at Chapman University
description: An architectural and acoustical triumph in Old Towne Orange, the Marybelle and Sebastian P. Musco Center for the Arts at Chapman University is a state-of-the-art 1,044-seat proscenium theater designed by Pfeiffer Partners Architects with acoustics by Nagata Acoustics (of Walt Disney Concert Hall fame). The center hosts an illustrious seasonal lineup of world-renowned symphonies, opera, jazz, contemporary dance, theatre, and Chapman student masterworks, opening onto the Bette and Wylie Aitken Arts Plaza.
